firstPlayerRule: In multiplayer, whoever most recently defeated a Worm in combat goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Choose starting Locations in reverse player order, beginning with the last player. This setup order does not change who takes the first turn.
The starting player plays a Vehicle card, resolves it, refills their hand, and checks for a possible Worm Attack. Turns then continue clockwise.
In solo play, the human uses one squad; the Worms’ separate Terror Turn happens after each human turn.
